desc: The Smith & Wesson SD9 2.0 Pistol combines compact design and power, measuring 7.2 inches overall and weighing 1.42 pounds. Its satin-finished slide features aggressive front serrations, paired with a textured grip on the front, sides, and back. The 4-inch stainless steel barrel delivers performance, complemented by a Picatinny-style rail for customization. The SD9 2.0 features white-dot sights, a 16-round magazine capacity, and an enhanced Self Defense Trigger featuring a flat-face design.
